title: Micron folds over Netlist memory patent dispute
key_facts: Micron and Netlist settled their patent litigation.
Micron signed a 5-year licence for Netlist memory IP and pays $600 million in licence fees.
Payments are $30 million a quarter until the third quarter of 2031; Micron also bought $1 million of Netlist common stock.
Netlist has now won IP disputes against Micron, Samsung and SK hynix, with fees valued at $1.54 billion.
In August Samsung agreed to pay Netlist $897 million over 5 years for server DIMM and HBM technology licences.
Netlist still has a case against Google since 2008 over U.S. Patent No. 7,289,386.

why_it_matters_hint: Micron licenses Netlist IP; third big memory maker to pay.
